message.content: {"caption":"Microsoft logo with its four-color square mark and gray wordmark.","description":"A Microsoft logo: four equal colored squares arranged in a 2-by-2 grid—orange-red at upper left, green at upper right, blue at lower left, and yellow at lower right—followed by the gray word “Microsoft.” In the page context, it identifies Microsoft as the organization associated with the document.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
